about_the_game:
A rogueli*e deckbuilder where all your cards are lottery scratch off tickets!

  • Engage in active time battles and manipulate the flow of time with Spinner Gadgets.
  • Build your deck by buying new cards and converting cards into upgrades for other cards.
  • Create synergies with persistent and/or consumable gadgets that interact with cards, other gadgets, and moment to moment combat outcomes.
  • Each card is unique and how you scratch it matters. Speed, precision and quick decision making are needed to win.
  • Lots of different status effects and card/gadget synergies make for a wide range of builds and approaches to battle!

This game has been in development over the last few years with a goal of having a demo out in 2026 and releasing the full game by 2027-2028. Expect to see new cards, gadgets, maps, upgrades and opponents as development proceeds.

content_descriptors.notes: The theme of the game has to do with gambling and the problems associated with it. The story has light-hearted but serious conversations about addiction and gambling.
